strategy_roster.name: Tokyo Session
strategy_roster.notes: The reference-candle channel is rendered as a 10-bar Donchian range and the ContraryTrend mode (the first documented signal mode) fades an overextended spike back through the band, which is also the documented CloseInSignal exit. The reference/check hours, MinDistanceOfLevel/MaxDistanceOfLevel in pips, ReCheckPrices and CheckAllBars, break-even and the time-close exit are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Hull Ma Rsi
strategy_roster.notes: Hull MA cannot be computed, so the documented HmaPeriod 9 is approximated with EMA(9) and a change of its direction is the exit; the documented RsiPeriod 14 oversold gate is widened from 30 to 40 because a rising Hull with RSI below 30 is unreachable. StopLoss is documented as an absolute unit of 2, not a percentage, so protection is null.

strategy_roster.name: Sudoku UI
strategy_roster.notes: The repurposed Sudoku grid only contributes deviation levels, so the documented mean-reversion idea is kept with a 2% SMA(20) deviation (SmaPeriod is not documented) and the return into the neutral band closes. The 9x9 board generation, shuffling seeds, EliminateLabel, ThresholdRange/NeutralBand values and puzzle regeneration on date change are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Multi Lot Scalper
strategy_roster.notes: Only the documented MACD-histogram slope direction is kept, using the documented MacdFastLength 14, MacdSlowLength 26 and MacdSignalLength 9. The martingale ladder (MaxTrades 10, EntryDistancePips 15), 40-pip take-profit, 20-pip trailing, secure-profit protection, money management and the 2005-2006 date/hour window are not DSL signals.

strategy_roster.name: CE XAU/USDT
strategy_roster.notes: Directly implements the documented rule: a close crossing above the SMA period 14 opens the long and the reverse cross closes it. The 1-minute candle choice and the documented 'no stops' setting are carried over unchanged.

strategy_roster.name: Hans123Trader RangeBreakout
strategy_roster.notes: The break of the most recent trading range becomes a 20-bar Donchian channel (no range length is documented) with a mirrored exit. The twice-daily EndSession triggers, pending-order refresh, forced rollover close and point-based stop/target/trailing distances are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Quest Research
strategy_roster.notes: The documented OpenPeriod 50 channel upper band and ClosePeriod 50 opposite band are used directly, with the previous-bar band standing in for the intrabar touch of the exit band. Docs list no stops.

strategy_roster.name: TradePad
strategy_roster.notes: This is a manual trading panel driven by tick, notification, timer and chart-message events with discretionary order placement, so there is no market-derived signal and the never-true guard is used. User-implemented custom stop logic is by definition not a DSL rule.

strategy_roster.name: Two Per Bar
strategy_roster.notes: The routine opens a hedged long and short at the start of every bar and liquidates the basket on the next bar, so it is bar-schedule driven with no directional market signal and the never-true guard is used. The martingale VolumeMultiplier, MaxVolume and TakeProfitPoints 50 ladder are order-management, not entry logic.

strategy_roster.name: Gaps
strategy_roster.notes: The documented gap rule (open below the previous low by GapPips) is expressed in percent, using 0.5% as the pip-equivalent buffer, and the exit is the gap fill. StopLossPips 50 and TakeProfitPips 50 are pip distances rather than percentages, so the stepped 5/5-pip trailing and pending-order cancellation are dropped.
